svg.title: Artificial Intelligence
svg.desc: Artificial Intelligence. I am interested in AI not only as a technology, but as a new way to design software. I like exploring how AI systems can reason, assist, automate, explain, and collaborate with humans. Areas: AI agents, Large language models, Human-AI collaboration, Autonomous workflows, Reasoning systems, Conversational interfaces, Voice-based AI, Machine learning applied to real products.
